name: STA304H1 — Correction Attribution (Sampling Bias and Nonresponse)
description: 'A large sample automatically represents the population.' WRONG! A biased large sample is WORSE than a small unbiased one. Literary Digest poll (1936)

steps.template_en: 'A large sample automatically represents the population.' WRONG! A biased large sample is WORSE than a small unbiased one. Literary Digest poll (1936): 2.4M responses predicted Landon → Roosevelt won. Response bias!
steps.template_zh: '大样本自动代表总体。'错！有偏大样本比小的无偏样本更糟。Literary Digest民调(1936)：240万回复预测Landon→Roosevelt胜。回复偏差！

steps.template_en: US presidential election 1936: Literary Digest sent 10M postcards (from phone books + car registrations). 2.4M returned → Landon 57%. Actual: Roosevelt 62%. Why? Sampling frame excluded poor voters (Great Depression). SELECTION BIAS.
steps.template_zh: 1936年大选：从电话簿+车牌发送1000万明信片。240万回复→Landon 57%。实际：Roosevelt 62%。抽样框排除穷人→选择性偏差。

steps.template_en: Types of bias: (1) Selection bias — frame doesn't match population. (2) Nonresponse bias — respondents differ from non-respondents. (3) Response bias — lying, misunderstanding. (4) Recall bias — memory errors.
steps.template_zh: 偏差类型：(1)选择性偏差。(2)无回答偏差。(3)回答偏差。(4)回忆偏差。

steps.template_en: Nonresponse: even 70% response rate can have severe bias if non-respondents differ systematically. Solutions: (1) Increase response rate. (2) Weighting adjustments (post-stratification). (3) Imputation. (4) Sensitivity analysis.
steps.template_zh: 无回答：即使70%回答率，若无回答者有系统性差异，偏差可能严重。解决：(1)提高回答率。(2)加权调整。(3)插补。(4)敏感性分析。

steps.template_en: A mail survey gets 30% response. Respondents tend to be older, wealthier, more educated. (1) Is the sample representative? (2) How would nonresponse bias affect estimates of income? (3) Design a weighting scheme using census data. (4) What's the likely direction of bias?
steps.template_zh: 邮件调查30%回答。回答者年龄更大、更富、更受教育。(1)样本有代表性吗？(2)无回答偏差如何影响收入估计？(3)用普查数据设计加权方案。(4)偏差方向？

steps.template_en: 'The plural of anecdote is not data.' Bias can NEVER be fixed by increasing sample size — only by improving the design. Register your survey design: target population, sampling frame, response rate, weighting plan.
steps.template_zh: '轶事的复数不是数据。'偏差永远不能通过增加样本量解决——只能通过改进设计。登记调查设计：目标总体、抽样框、回答率、加权计划。
